boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented University of Florida library study environments, spanning quiet individual work, collaborative rooms, and specialized settings.

cards.title: Library West Quiet Study Floor
cards.subtitle: Library West, fourth floor
cards.notes: Bring quiet individual work to the fourth floor and keep devices non-audible; move calls and collaborative discussion to another library area.
cards.short_summary: A designated quiet floor for individual study during Library West open hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Library West designates its fourth floor as quiet study, available first-come, first-served while the building is open.
cards.source_title: Quiet Study Floor | Library West | UF Libraries
cards.access_notes: First-come, first-served during Library West building open hours; group study is limited to designated group rooms.

cards.title: Library West Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Library West, reservable rooms
cards.notes: Reserve through LibCal with at least one other group member, save the confirmation, and use the room for collaborative work rather than solo study.
cards.short_summary: Reservable Library West rooms for groups of two or more.
cards.evidence_claim: Current UF students can reserve Library West group study rooms through LibCal for up to two hours per day, with two or more people required.
cards.source_title: Group Study Rooms | Library West | UF Libraries
cards.access_notes: Current UF student reservation required; rooms are for group study of two or more, not individual study or proctored exams.

cards.title: Library West Graduate Study Floor
cards.subtitle: Library West, sixth floor
cards.notes: If you are an enrolled UF graduate student, use the sixth-floor individual-study area; confirm your access before heading upstairs.
cards.short_summary: A quiet individual-study floor restricted to enrolled UF graduate students.
cards.evidence_claim: UF Libraries identifies Library West's sixth floor as a quiet individual-study area reserved for enrolled UF graduate students.
cards.source_title: Study & Testing Spaces | George A. Smathers Libraries
cards.access_notes: Reserved for enrolled UF graduate students; undergraduate and post-baccalaureate students taking graduate-level courses are excluded.

cards.title: Marston Science Library Collaboration Commons
cards.subtitle: Marston Science Library, first floor
cards.notes: Set up a group work session on the first floor, where the library places group-study rooms, computers, printing, and its collaboration commons.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor collaborative work setting with study rooms and technology nearby.
cards.evidence_claim: Marston's first floor includes more than 700 seats, 21 group study rooms, printing support, and the Collaboration Commons.
cards.source_title: Floorplans and Location | Marston Science Library | UF Libraries
cards.access_notes: Use the first-floor collaboration setting for group work; individual room use is governed by Marston's study-room policy.

cards.entity_name: Marston Science Library Second-Floor Study Area
cards.title: Marston Science Library Second-Floor Study Area
cards.subtitle: Marston Science Library, second floor
cards.notes: Choose this floor when you need group discussion alongside library services, course reserves, technology circulation, printing, and scanning.
cards.short_summary: A second-floor study area combining group work space with service and technology resources.
cards.evidence_claim: Marston's second floor provides group-study and discussion space along with a service desk, four group rooms, technology circulation, printing, and scanning.
cards.source_title: Floorplans and Location | Marston Science Library | UF Libraries
cards.access_notes: A group-study and discussion area; consult the library's study-room policy before reserving a room.

cards.entity_name: Marston Science Library Third-Floor Study Area
cards.title: Marston Science Library Third-Floor Study Area
cards.subtitle: Marston Science Library, third floor
cards.notes: Use the third floor for work that benefits from a discussion-friendly area near journals, theses, the aquarium, and data consultation resources.
cards.short_summary: A discussion-friendly Marston floor near research collections and data support.
cards.evidence_claim: UF Libraries lists Marston's third floor as a group-study and discussion area with journals, theses and dissertations, an aquarium, and a data consultation room.
cards.source_title: Floorplans and Location | Marston Science Library | UF Libraries
cards.access_notes: Designed for group study and discussion; library building access and conduct rules apply.

cards.entity_name: Marston Science Library Fourth-Floor Quiet Study
cards.title: Marston Science Library Fourth-Floor Quiet Study
cards.subtitle: Marston Science Library, fourth floor
cards.notes: Take individual reading or writing to the fourth floor, which the library identifies as quiet study and locates with its Books A–Z collection.
cards.short_summary: A quiet Marston floor for individual work amid the general book collection.
cards.evidence_claim: UF Libraries designates Marston's fourth floor as a quiet individual-study area; its floorplan lists Books A–Z and oversized books there.
cards.source_title: Floorplans and Location | Marston Science Library | UF Libraries
cards.access_notes: Quiet individual-study area; follow Marston's library conduct expectations.

cards.entity_name: Marston Science Library Fifth-Floor Silent Study
cards.title: Marston Science Library Fifth-Floor Silent Study
cards.subtitle: Marston Science Library, fifth floor
cards.notes: For concentrated individual work, head to the fifth floor and keep the setting silent as the library designates for this level.
cards.short_summary: A designated silent individual-study area at the top of Marston Science Library.
cards.evidence_claim: UF Libraries identifies Marston's fifth floor as a silent individual-study area and the floorplan labels it for silent study.
cards.source_title: Floorplans and Location | Marston Science Library | UF Libraries
cards.access_notes: Silent individual-study area; library building access and conduct rules apply.

cards.entity_name: Architecture & Fine Arts Library Reading Room
cards.title: Architecture & Fine Arts Library Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Architecture & Fine Arts Library, service floor
cards.notes: Use a powered carrel or larger table in the Reading Room, and keep extended group discussion elsewhere because sound carries in the open library.
cards.short_summary: A quiet reading room with powered carrels, tables, and a sound-conscious atmosphere.
cards.evidence_claim: The AFA Library Reading Room has double-decker carrels with electrical outlets and larger study tables; the library describes itself as a small, quiet open space.
cards.source_title: Study Space | Architecture & Fine Arts Library | UF Libraries
cards.access_notes: Study space is available on both floors; extended group discussion is discouraged and food is not permitted.

cards.entity_name: Health Science Center Library Individual Study Rooms
cards.title: Health Science Center Library Individual Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Health Science Center Library, reservable rooms
cards.notes: Book an individual room online in half-hour increments when you need a dedicated workspace, then retain the email confirmation for your reservation.
cards.short_summary: Reservable individual study rooms at the Health Science Center Library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Health Science Center Library offers 18 individual study rooms for online reservations in half-hour increments, up to four hours per session.
cards.source_title: Health Science Center Library Study Spaces | UF Libraries LibCal
cards.access_notes: Online booking is available to current UF students and UF Health residents or fellows; reservations may run up to four hours per session.
